name: admin-proposals
description: The gate of the agent's changes to itself: its pull requests from pikit/self/* listed in the dashboard, with their diff and checks, approved (merged) or rejected there with a token the agent never holds; and the project's CI workflow.

environment.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment.description: A GitHub token that reads the project's repository: its pull requests and their checks. The agent's own (execution-do's) does; it never merges.

environment.name: PIKIT_MERGE_TOKEN
environment.description: A GitHub token that merges and closes the agent's pull requests when you approve or reject them in the dashboard: fine-grained, this repository only, Contents and Pull requests read and write. Never the agent's token.
